basic_info.description: Welcome to this top-floor unit, where abundant natural light and a skylight create an open, airy atmosphere. Enjoy the convenience of dedicated covered parking and additional storage, along with access to a spacious shared backyard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. With low HOA fees that cover water, sewer, trash, common area maintenance, and building insurance, you'll find hassle-free living here. This location boasts an excellent walk score and fantastic transit options, making it easy to get around. You're just moments away from vibrant shops and restaurants, as well as Lincoln Park and Community Center. Commuters will appreciate the proximity to Daly City BART stations, Stonestown, H Mart, and Westlake Shopping Central just a short drive away. This unit is ideal for first-time buyers or investors looking for a fantastic opportunity in a sought-after neighborhood. Don't miss out on this gem!
